recentItems.title: CLINTON EPSTEIN PROBE LIVE | Bill Clinton Grilled Under Oath Over Jeffrey Epstein Connections
recentItems.description:
Former U.S. President Bill Clinton and former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton have provided under-oath depositions to the House Oversight Committee as part of a congressional investigation into the network of late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. In the released closed-door testimony, Bill Clinton strongly denied any wrongdoing, stating under oath that he 'saw nothing' and had no knowledge of Epstein's crimes, asserting he would have reported Epstein to authorities had he known. Clinton acknowledged flying on Epstein’s private jet approximately a dozen times for humanitarian work but maintained he ended all contact with the financier in 2003. Meanwhile, Hillary Clinton testified that she had no recollection of ever meeting Epstein, while Republican lawmakers questioned the couple on visitor logs showing Epstein visited the White House 17 times during the Clinton presidency. The high-profile inquiry comes amid broader public pressure and the release of millions of Department of Justice documents under the Epstein Files Transparency Act.
